q: How do I calculate the carbon footprint of wall putty per kg?
title: Wall putty carbon footprint per kg
short: In cement-based putty, white cement usually drives most of the footprint: multiply the cement per kg by the cement maker's figure. Add calcite, polymer and bags, then blending and packing electricity divided by kg packed.
audience: Wall putty and building chemical makers

ul: Dry blending in ribbon or plough mixers.

p: Report per kg by product. Cement content drives most of the figure, so give the white cement share.

example.title: Worked example: wall putty unit per kg (one month)
lines: Plant total: 14,200 / 2,000,000 = 0.00710 kg CO2 per kg
Add white cement and polymer for the full figure
example.note: Inputs are illustrative; use your own bills and production records.

senseible: Senseible reads the plant's electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and fuel invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record, the plant-level input to a per-unit figure. Bought-in materials go to the supplier evidence trail; product reports are self-declared drafts.
